ModMetaData.name: The Cooler
ModMetaData.author: TheFarawayDev
ModMetaData.description: The Cooler is a freestanding, high-efficiency space cooling device designed by TheFarawayDev. It functions as an inverted space heater, cooling rooms directly to a target temperature without requiring exhaust vents or wall-mounting, and features a cold-blue glow and room boundary overlay.
